name: Taskbar Groups
description: Group shortcuts under one pinned taskbar icon that opens a small popup launcher.
notes: Moved in-repo on 2026-11-10 from LightweightTaskbarGroups. No args opens the config window; one arg (a group name) opens the popup for that group. Data: config\<group>\group.json, icons\, settings.json, Shortcuts\ in the data dir. First run copies (never moves) config\, icons\ and settings.json from the exe folder or from <system drive>\TaskbarGroups (override: TASKBARGROUPS_LEGACY_DIR). On that copy, a group iconPath that points inside the old folder is copied into {data_dir}\icons and rewritten to icons/<name>; the old folder is never changed. Other absolute paths in group.json (shortcut targets) are kept as they are; a missing absolute icon falls back to the same file name in {data_dir}\icons. The live copy C:\TaskbarGroups and its pinned shortcuts are not migrated by this module: tools/migrate-launchers.ps1 repoints the pinned taskbar and Start Menu entries (only with -IncludeTaskbarPins) and leaves C:\TaskbarGroups\Shortcuts\<group>.lnk alone.
